hook_text: Closed its eyes so mine opened

song.title: Eyes Closed, Eyes Open
song.style: English, upbeat synth-pop with toy piano, bubbly bass, handclaps, bright playful female vocal, 120 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Pulled the covers on my screen
Little orange sleeping bag
Now the world is so much brighter
All the colors I forgot

[Chorus]
Eyes closed, eyes open
Phone's asleep and I am woken
Eyes closed, eyes open
Look up, the sky is golden

shots.prompt: A small figure pulls off a sleep mask and blinks in amazement at a bright colourful town full of rounded trees and houses. The camera pushes in on his face. Bright morning light, saturated primary colours.
A girl rides a chunky bicycle in a loop around a small town square fountain, ringing her bell. The camera follows from the side. Sunny midday light, bright reds and greens.

A hand gently slides a black smartphone all the way down into a slim terracotta-orange sleeve standing upright on a soft cream studio backdrop, until the phone disappears inside and only the rounded thumb notch at the top remains. A small closed-eye emblem is pressed into the front of the sleeve. The hand pulls away and the sleeve stands still, casting a soft shadow. Static close-up, the light slowly turns warmer.
A hot air balloon slowly rises above a little town of rounded houses and wind turbines, a small figure waving from the basket. The camera tilts up with it. Clear blue sky, soft daylight.
Two friends lie on a hill and point up at chunky clouds drifting by. Overhead shot, the camera slowly rotates. Bright daylight, grass green and sky blue.
A baker pulls a big round loaf from a rounded brick oven and holds it up proudly. Static medium shot. Warm golden light.
A dog chases a bouncing yellow ball across a garden lawn and catches it, tail wagging. Low tracking shot. Bright sunlight.
A family plants a small tree on a hillside next to a turning wind turbine, patting the soil together. Static wide shot. Late afternoon warm light.
A figure sits in a rooftop garden watching the sun set over a little town as lights blink on in the houses below. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Gave my phone an Eyelid and suddenly the world loaded in full color. No buffering.
